species: The peptide spectra were searched against the P. falciparum database to identify proteins associated with PfMed31.
tissue: 6 mL of infected blood (>10% parasitemia, 2% hematocrit) was harvested for the experiment.
cell_type: Parasites were released from infected erythrocytes by 0.1% saponin treatment and lysed using 50–200 μL of the parasite lysis buffer (4% SDS, 0.5% Triton X-100) in the presence of freshly added protease inhibitors.
disease_state: 6 mL of infected blood (>10% parasitemia, 2% hematocrit) was harvested for the experiment.
sample_source: This research involved the use of human blood drawn from healthy volunteers by trained healthcare professionals and was approved by the NTU Institutional Review Board and assigned the IRB approval number IRB-2013-07-020.
strain: P. falciparum T996 strain parasites were cultured at 2% hematocrit in RPMI 1640 medium containing 0.25% Albumax, 0.2% sodium bicarbonate, and 0.01 mg/mL gentamicin.
